Requirements You are wielding your scepter regalia.

You command your allies as if they were your most devout followers. You command an ally to perform a basic action, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]. You are then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn as you split your attention between yourself and them.
